# Which dog classes pay your hourly rate, and which ones underpay?

> Price each breed class from its real minutes, drive time, supplies and no-shows, then audit past appointments to see which classes underpay. Your numbers, not market rates. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
